lesson: NEVER trade contracts priced 35¢–65¢ — Kalshi fees in this range are 4× higher than at the edges (5¢–20¢ or 80¢–95¢) and destroy all profit on small accounts.
Ensemble weather models have known biases; always apply a 10% humility buffer to account for model disagreement and data staleness.
For markets with extremely low probabilities (<5%), avoid trading even with apparent large relative edges due to high model uncertainty and minimal absolute profit potential.
Do not trade markets with logically contradictory or ambiguous questions that make probability estimation impossible.
